text: Two-week follow-up on osimertinib therapy. Patient reports mild diarrhea, controlled with dietary modifications. No rash. Minimal fatigue. ECOG performance status remains 1. No dose-limiting toxicities. Labs: CBC stable, LFTs normal. Plan: Continue osimertinib 80 mg daily. Repeat CT chest scheduled for 8 weeks to assess tumor response. Patient encouraged to maintain activity level and report any new symptoms.
